name: Grade 6 T3 Practice: November Week 2 - micro:bit Input and Output
description: Practice words for micro:bit parts, inputs, and outputs.

words.definition: A tiny computer used to learn coding.
words.example: The micro:bit showed a heart icon.

words.definition: A button press or sensor action that tells the micro:bit what to do.
words.example: A button press is an input.

words.definition: What the micro:bit shows or does after the program runs.
words.example: A sound can be an output.

words.definition: A tiny light in the micro:bit display.
words.example: The LED turned red when the program started.

words.definition: A part you press to give input.
words.example: Button A made the number increase.

words.definition: A screen or lights that show output.

words.example: The icon appeared on the LED display.
